xmldoc.short_description: Export a figure to an image or document file.

param_input_item.param_description: Figure graphics object. When omitted, the current figure returned by gcf() is used.
Character vector or string scalar: destination filename.
Character vector or string scalar: a -d device option (for example '-dpng', '-dpdf', '-dsvg'). When omitted, the format is inferred from the filename extension.
Character vector or string scalar: a -r resolution option (for example '-r150'). Accepted for compatibility; the export follows the figure size.

description.p: print exports a figure to an image or document file. It is a thin wrapper over saveas: the -d device option selects the output format and the figure is exported through the shared desktop, web and headless renderer.

When no -d device is given, the format is inferred from the filename extension, and PNG is used when the filename has no extension. A -r resolution option is accepted for compatibility but does not resample the output.
The device option maps to the same format registry as saveas:
Background: as with saveas, while the figure InvertHardcopy property is 'on' (the default), the exported background is white whatever the on-screen figure Color.

example_item.example_item_description: Export the current figure to PNG, PDF and SVG.
Infer the format from the filename extension.
